decisions.reason: The award is a strong early signal and the product builds on our metal-processing know-how, so our existing knowledge base gives us good scope to learn and improve it commercially.

This geothermal probe is adjacent to our competencies in steel-based engineered components, and despite limited visible market feedback we can absorb lessons from the first launch phase and refine it.

Surface technology is related to our metallurgical and processing capabilities, but because its success depends on the geothermal line and evidence is still thin it carries a somewhat higher rationalisation risk.

A fire-protection steel profile system sits very close to our established core knowledge in steel products for construction, which makes continued improvement and market application relatively straightforward.
A slim steel profile system is highly consistent with our existing product and engineering base, so we are well placed to interpret market feedback and exploit the product further.

The decorative steel profile surface system is still closely related to our profile and finishing expertise, though its more design-led demand makes it a bit more exposed if early traction proves weaker than expected.
